correctness.rationale: The conditional completion lemma is proved by contracting prescribed partial-injection paths, leaving a uniform permutation on n-r paths, and gives H_(n-r)+closed cycles. For each of six triple orders, loops/two-cycles/three-cycles are counted over the equally likely image subsets, yielding K_sigma and the stated normalizations. All integer numerators are 1 mod 3; signs and global sums follow. Independent exact-rational enumeration checks every positional and global covariance through n=8, and tests randomly generated partial injections through n=7 (900 assertions). This is not an inference from finite data.

value.rationale: The all-size six-pattern table reveals a concrete local-to-global dependence mechanism: despite cycle count being conjugacy invariant, conditioning on a specified ordinal triple changes its expected value with an affine positional profile, and four patterns have strictly changing covariance signs at about one-quarter or three-quarters of the word. The exact congruence excludes every zero covariance; global pattern-count correlations follow with explicit contrasting signs. These are useful finite baseline mixed moments not determined by ordinary marginal pattern counts or pairwise inversion covariance.
